skills.skill: Determine a percent of a whole number

misconceptions.pattern: Divides by 10 instead of 100 when converting the percent (e.g. 25% of 80 answered 200 rather than 20), misplacing the decimal.

strategies.intent: Read pct% as pct hundredths: multiply the whole by the percent, then divide by 100 (two decimal places). 10% is one tenth, 50% is one half, 25% is one quarter.
